evidence_snippets: View Managed Service for Apache Spark resource metrics You can select and view the Managed Service for Apache Spark resource metrics in the Metrics Explorer by typing "dataproc" in the Filter by resource or metric name box, then selecting a "Cloud Dataproc" resource.

"Managed Service for Apache Spark" is the new name for the product formerly known as "Dataproc on Compute Engine" (cluster deployment) and "Google Cloud Serverless for Apache Spark" (serverless deployment).
